title: 京王杯ジュニアSにむけて

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Well, I was… a little sad.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: This might be the last time I get to Bakushin a sprint.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Saying such a thing… Perhaps she has started to understand the appeal of sprints?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: It's such a shame. You know…

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: The spectators will surely be upset too!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: There may be people out there born solely to witness this divine speed… a speed that can tear short-distance tracks to shreds!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: But one must do what one has to do! A representative always needs to act for the greater good…

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: The only thing I can do is make sure I go out with a bang!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: As a tribute to everyone, I'll show them a splendid victory!
